name.description: Identifier name for the drive instance (filename-safe, used for cache and log paths).

remote.description: Rclone remote name with trailing colon and optional subpath (e.g. 'gdrive:').

drive_letter.description: Windows drive letter with trailing colon (e.g. 'E:').

volume_name.description: Volume display label visible in Windows File Explorer.

cache_dir.description: Local path for VFS file caching. Recommend redirecting away from system C: drive.

cache_size.description: Maximum size cap for the local disk cache (e.g. '20G').

cache_min_free_space.description: Target minimum free space to keep on the cache drive (e.g. '15G').

buffer_size.description: Memory buffer size per open file stream (e.g. '16M' or '0').

vfs_read_ahead.description: Extra sequential read-ahead buffered on disk in VFS full cache mode (e.g. '128M').

read_chunk_size.description: Initial or fixed chunk size requested during streaming reads (e.g. '16M').

read_chunk_limit.description: Maximum chunk size ceiling when read_chunk_streams is 0 (e.g. '256M').

read_chunk_streams.description: Number of parallel chunk read streams (0 uses progressive chunking up to read_chunk_limit).

upload_chunk_size.description: Chunk size for multipart cloud uploads (e.g. '32M' for Google Drive, '50Mi' for OneDrive).

transfers.description: Maximum concurrent background VFS uploads for dirty files.

dir_cache_time.description: Duration to cache directory listings in memory (e.g. '72h').

attr_timeout.description: Duration the kernel caches file attributes and sizes (default '1s' to avoid stale-size corruption).

poll_interval.description: Interval between remote change-notification polls on supported backends (e.g. '1m').

vfs_cache_max_age.description: Maximum age since last access before clean cached objects are evicted (e.g. '168h').

vfs_write_back.description: Delay after file close before uploading dirty cached files (e.g. '5s').

no_modtime.description: Skip reading and writing modification times (useful for S3/Swift object storage; false by default on Drive/OneDrive).

vfs_refresh.description: Pre-warm directory cache recursively in the background on mount start.

read_only.description: Mount as read-only volume if true.

network_mode.description: Mount as a network share instead of a fixed local disk when true.

icon.description: Absolute or relative path to a .ico file for custom File Explorer branding.
